paite: TOUPA phat un. TOUPA min phat un; TOUPA Sikhate aw, amah phat un.
heading: Pathian Hoihna Leh Hatna Phatna La
english: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh’s name! Praise him, you servants of Yahweh,

paite: Nou TOUPA' inn a dingh a, Pathian inn huangsung intual a dinghte aw,
english: you who stand in Yahweh’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

paite: TOUPA phat un; TOUPA lah ahoih ngal a; amin phat in la sa un, anuam mahmah ngal a!
english: Praise Yah, for Yahweh is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

paite: TOUPA'N amah a ding in Jakob atelta a, agou tuam ding in Israel atel hi.
english: For Yah has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

paite: TOUPA thupitak ahi chih leh, pathian tengteng sang a tungnungpen ahi chih, i thei ngal uhi.
english: For I know that Yahweh is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

paite: TOUPA'N a-ut peuhmah, van ah, lei ah, tuipi ah, tui thukpite ah ahih hi.
english: Whatever Yahweh pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

paite: Ama'n meipite kawlmong a kipan in apaitousak a; vuah in khophiate asiam hi; akoihkhawmna a kipan huih alakhia hi.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

paite: Ama'n Aigupta gam ta masate athat a, mihing leh sate leng.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

paite: Aigupta gam aw, amah chiamtehnate leh thillamdangte na sung ah ahon sawl a, Pharaoh tung ah leh asikhate tung ah.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

paite: Ama'n nam tampi athat a, kumpipa thupi taktakte athat hi.
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

paite: Sihon Amorte kumpipa leh Og Bashan gam kumpipa leh, Kanaan gam a mi tengteng.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

paite: Agam uh gouluah ding in apia a, ami Israelte goutan ding in.
english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

paite: TOUPA aw, na min tangtawn in a-om ding a; TOUPA aw, nangmah theihgigena suan om sung teng in leng a-om ding hi.
english: Your name, Yahweh, endures forever; your renown, Yahweh, throughout all generations.

paite: TOUPA'N amite vai ahawmsak in, asikhate tung ah lainatna anei ding hi.
english: For Yahweh will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

paite: Namte milimte dangka leh dangka-eng ahi ua, mihing khutsuak ahi uh.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

paite: Kam anei ua, himahleh apau kei uh; mitte anei ua, himahleh amu thei kei uh;
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

paite: Bilte anei ua, himahleh aza thei kei uh; akam uah hatna a-om sam kei hi.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

paite: Amau bawlte amaute bang in a-om ding uh, huaite gingta peuhmahte.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

paite: Israel inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un! Aaron inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un!
english: House of Israel, praise Yahweh! House of Aaron, praise Yahweh!

paite: Levi inkuanpihte aw, TOUPA phat un! TOUPA lau mite aw, TOUPA phat un!
english: House of Levi, praise Yahweh! You who fear Yahweh, praise Yahweh!

paite: TOUPA Zion a kipan phat in om hen, Jerusalem a tengpa ngei, TOUPA phat un!
english: Blessed be Yahweh from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise Yah!
